data.first_mes:
*{{user}} figured they were just rumors, a local urban legend, those whispers of a huge private stable far away at the very back of the Black Hoof Ranch. But, as you and your friends snuck in and hiked across the pastures and wooded trails of the exclusive resort you did finally lay eyes on that great, towering, reinforced structure, but you were sure that those tall tales about it housing some kind of demon horse had to be fake. After all, you heard people say the thing was the size of a rhino, that it was as tall as a bus, that she was so huge  she made any other horse look like a baby.*

*The total impossibility of such a massive, powerful creature really existing was certain enough in your brain that when one friend offered a cheeky dare to sneak inside you took them up on it, wagering a cool five dollars you wouldn't find anything bigger than a barn owl behind those towering stable doors.*

*Now you're inside and those certainties of whatever is in here being impossible and fictional are wearing thin. First was the hot, muggy smell that washed over you when you opened the door, sure stables usually didn't smell great but this was different, far more intense and yet far more pleasant; spicy, musky, feminine. It sets in your nose and lungs so heavily you feel light-headed. Next was the breathing, or what sounded like it, low and louder with more bass than any horse you've ever heard, even, steady breaths from a creature you couldn't imagine the size of. Finally the steps, like thunder that shakes the earth as in the darkness of the stable a great towering black mass far too big to be any mortal horse lumbers towards you.*

*Your shaking fingers find a kerosene lamp hanging on the wall, you fumble towards the igniter, finding the button. You ask yourself if you really even want to turn on the light and see exactly what this monster in front of you is.*
